author: NotPineapple203
body:
Yo yo yo, it's your boi here,

I am in the planning phase for my next map and it involves "organic" floating islands. So I was wondering what are some techniques you guys use to make smooth organic looking floating islands. I was planning on using tnt on a big chunk of blocks. I'd like to know if there are any other techniques that the community uses. Please keep them to vanilla minecraft only (No WorldEdit or anything like that). I like having my builds in vanilla.

Thanks

replies.author: NotPineapple203
replies.body: I don't need world edit because all I WOULD use is /fill and /clone which are both in vanilla. And also it feels like more of an accomplishment knowing that you did something in vanilla. And it also is that time consuming. For instance the map I just released, Hourglass. I built it in 4 days. Vanilla only. And I'd say it's fairly large.
